note: Exhausting kg's fixed arena from a let-local raises (arena-exhaustion) and the handler that names it catches: answers `caught`. Before the Phase 9 pin the same form let the error escape, because the condition object was degraded to nil and only a (t ...) handler matched. No Emacs equivalent: Emacs has no arena to exhaust. The kg_test that runs this form pins the arena at 1 MiB with $KG_LISP_ARENA_BYTES: the compiled default is 10 MiB since Phase B of doc/plans/2026-08-19-fe-simplification-and-cheap-compat.md, and one evaluation's step budget runs out at roughly 97000 conses, so a fill loop in an arena of 586986 slots raises the uncatchable step-limit wall instead.
